regions.label: Market stall and vendor
regions.description: A vendor behind a stall of cheese, bread, apples and garlic, a customer in a cloak, awning overhead.

catalog.note: Awning, goods and vendor read in the strip; the food is the giveaway.

prep.note: Warm awning + figure silhouette reads as a stall at 48px.

lists1.note: A wide band over the produce counter still reads as a market.

regions.label: Cobbled market street
regions.description: A cobbled lane between timbered houses with walkers and a dog, an arched gate and banners ahead.

visualQa.distinct: overlaps the archetype picture the Catalog already shows

catalog.note: Archway and walkers hold in the strip.

prep.note: Figures dissolve into noise at 48px; reads as a generic old town.

regions.label: Inn terrace on the street
regions.description: Patrons around a table under the awning of a timbered inn with a griffin sign; a barrel and a lantern beside the door.

visualQa.distinct: the only exterior inn in the library

catalog.note: Sign, awning, drinkers: an inn on a street.

regions.label: Clock tower and gate
regions.description: A conventional stone clock tower with a pointed spire above a blue-bannered archway.
regions.notes: Beautiful, and reads instantly — but no environment describes an ordinary clock tower or town gate. Its only literal matches (a frozen, 300ft arcane clocktower; a shattered haunted watchtower; a wizard's tower) are exactly the invented-semantics cases the brief forbids.

regions.label: Hearth and common room
regions.description: A stone fireplace with a blazing fire, a daylit window and a rug; tables and chairs in the room beyond.

catalog.note: The fire alone says hearth; strong focal point.

prep.note: Brightest crop of the pilot at 48px.

regions.label: Bar counter with casks
regions.description: A wooden bar with casks, bottles and tankards on shelves, candles, a stag banner overhead.

catalog.note: Casks on shelves read as a bar.

regions.label: Laid table (still life)
regions.description: Bread, cheese, apples, a pitcher and a candle on a table runner.
regions.notes: An isolated still life: it says "food", not "tavern" or "feast" — a generic object, the failure the brief warns about. Kept as a documented weak example.

regions.label: Bookshelves with banner
regions.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves of leather books and scroll bundles, creeping ivy, a banner with an open-book emblem.

catalog.note: Books and the open-book banner: unmistakable.

prep.note: Brown spines and scroll bundles read as a library.

regions.label: Scholar's desk
regions.description: A desk with a lantern, quill, an open map, scrolls, stacked books, a magnifying glass and an armillary sphere.

catalog.note: A 2.2:1 region in a 1:2.6 strip keeps only the lantern or only the scrolls: it stops saying "desk".

lists1.note: Best use of this region: a wide desk band.

lists3.note: Third tile keeps the lantern and book.

regions.label: Vaulted hall and tall window
regions.description: A pillared hall under a vault, light pouring through a tall mullioned window wrapped in ivy; a globe on the floor.

catalog.note: Window and rays make a strong vertical.

lists1.note: Band crop slices the window into a pale stripe; reads as a church.

regions.label: Trebuchet and crew
regions.description: A wooden trebuchet in silhouette against smoke and sun, its crew around it, a war banner beside.

visualQa.distinct: only siege engine in the library

catalog.note: The throwing arm is the whole picture.

lists1.note: In a 3.5:1 band the region becomes a grey blur: only the top of the arm survives.

regions.label: Castle curtain wall under attack
regions.description: Crenellated curtain walls and towers of a hilltop castle, a portcullis gate, fires and smoke, arrows in flight.

catalog.note: Towers and the burning wall read; the siege is evident, which is the point and the limit.

regions.label: Spaceport promenade
regions.description: A lamp-lit concourse with an orrery, travellers and a domed terminal behind a banner.

visualQa.distinct: no technological identity in this crop

regions.notes: Reads as a fantasy market hall: the sci-fi evidence (ships, planet) is outside the crop. Needs a different box.

regions.label: Docked starship at the spaceport
regions.description: A weathered starship resting on a docking platform with a planet and other ships behind it.

catalog.note: A long hull cannot live in a 1:2.6 strip: the ship is cut in half. Does not qualify.

prep.note: The hull is cropped at both ends in a square.

regions.label: Orbital ring and planet
regions.description: A large planet with a smaller moon, a segmented orbital ring and a floating tower-city, two ships under thrust.

catalog.note: Planet limb and a ship under thrust: space at a glance.

regions.label: Deck, mast and rigging
regions.description: The deck of a sailing ship: a lantern, casks, the mainmast with furled sail and rope rigging, the sea beyond the rail.

visualQa.distinct: close cousin of the archetype crop already used (x16)

catalog.note: Rigging and sail are the ship; nearly identical to the existing Seafaring strip.

regions.label: Distant lighthouse on the cliffs
regions.description: A small lighthouse on a headland above a harbour village, far across the water.
regions.notes: The lighthouse is ~50px tall in the master. Every frame would enlarge a smudge. The lab's resolution-insufficient example.

regions.label: Heavy sea off the rail
regions.description: Dark rolling waves with white crests seen over the ship's rail.
regions.notes: Generic open water with a hint of rail; it would stand for any sea. Only reads as a ship when the rail is kept in frame.
